title: Consolidated Financial Statements for the Year Ended 31 December 2025

headings.text: Consolidated Financial Statements for the Year Ended 31 December 2025

key_sentences: The directors present the consolidated financial statements of Hartwell Marine Holdings plc and its subsidiaries for the year ended 31 December 2025.
Group revenue grew by 6.9% to £482.6 million, and profit for the year rose by 16.7% to £56.6 million.
Ferry services remained the largest segment and contributed more than half of group revenue.
The third quarter was the strongest because of the summer passenger season.
These statements were approved by the board of directors on 12 March 2026.

rows: The statements include all entities controlled by the company at the year end.
Revenue is recognised when the voyage or service has been delivered to the customer.
Vessels are depreciated on a straight-line basis over 25 years.

list_items.text: The financial statements are prepared under the historical cost convention.
Amounts are presented in pounds sterling and rounded to the nearest £0.1 million.
Comparative figures for 2024 have been restated only where stated in the notes.
(a) Dry-docking costs are capitalised and depreciated over the period to the next docking.
(b) Short-term leases of less than twelve months are expensed as incurred.

notes: Flowing (not pre-paginated) financial statements in Calibri with Cambria headings; the page count is whatever the browser produced. Tables break across pages where the flow dictates; a table continued on the next page is ONE table and Chrome repeats the header row on each page (the repeat is NOT part of expected rows). Income statement: TWO-LEVEL header (first header row [Line item, Note, Year ended 31 December, Year ended 31 December, Change]; second header row [Line item, Note, 2025 £m, 2024 £m, Change]; merged cells repeat their text in every covered cell). Parentheses mark negatives, as printed. Blank Note cells are empty strings. Segment table is wide (8 columns) with a total row. The statement of financial position has section rows (Non-current assets, Current assets, Equity, Non-current liabilities, Current liabilities) and sub-total / total rows in the same table. The accounting-policy table is borderless with no header row. Lists: basis-of-preparation points are a CSS-drawn lower-roman list (no marker in text); the policy exceptions use TYPED "(a)" "(b)" markers (inline). Running header and footer are furniture, listed once; there are no page numbers. The masthead is furniture, not a heading.
